A feature we hope you never need.

We select Supercharger locations with safety in mind and relocate sites deemed unsafe. Our goal is that you always feel safe getting out to unplug.

We went back and forth on this for years, but believe offering it is the right call. Don't abuse it, so we don't have to restrict it.

Great work by many teams across Tesla to get this launched. We'll improve it quickly based on feedback.

It’s almost that time!

The @theXtakeover is coming to Giga Texas next week, October 9th & 10th!

It’s about @Tesla, @SpaceX, @boringcompany , @SpaceXAI , @neuralink & the amazing global community that supports the missions, employees & product owners of these companies & more importantly the brighter future they all are making possible! 

Cybertruck, Model Y, and Cybercab where they’re built!

Batteries & the foundational work being done at the Tesla Lithium plant!

Starbase, Starship, and a whole lot more!

Hear from @mayemusk , @woodhaus2 , @EricETesla  & special guest Nicki Minaj!

There will be a massive Tesla-themed light show by Xlightshows.io , car displays, product demonstrations, factory tours & so much more!

Activities begin on Friday the 9th & the main public event is on Saturday the 10th from 10 AM to 6 PM and then the official light show at 9 PM.

This is at Giga Texaas, 1 Tesla Road. 

This is an independent community event, with Tesla providing the venue.

Come out. I can’t wait to hang out with so many of you.

Starlink is driving a satellite internet boom in Spain. 🇪🇸🛰️

Satellite connections nearly tripled in 2025, reaching 98,391.

That’s nearly 10× growth since 2022, with Spain’s regulator pointing to Starlink as the main force behind the surge.

The service is bringing high-speed internet to rural and remote areas.

Video

BREAKING: Tesla sales in Spain jumped 24.8% year over year in September. 🇪🇸⚡️

Tesla delivered 3,733 new vehicles during the month, according to registration data from ANFAC cited by Reuters.

For the first nine months of 2026, Tesla sales in Spain are up 9.5% compared with the same period in 2025.

BREAKING: Tesla registrations rose across several major European markets in September. 🇪🇺⚡️

• 🇫🇷 France: +61.9%
• 🇸🇪 Sweden: +38.4%
• 🇳🇴 Norway: +2.2%
• 🇪🇸 Spain: +24.8%

Tesla registrations across the EU, Britain and EFTA were also up 43.3% from January through August.

The European recovery is gaining momentum. 🚗

We sure had a fun time in 2023. Looking forward to  @theXtakeover on October 10. See you soon 🥰🥰
